notes.title: Major Update: Version 1.23
notes.content:
I combined 2 updates into one here. In ver.1.22, Lupin Village is a new late-game location. It's found by beating the Minotaurs at the far right of the main village. Lupin village is a separate questline for Harlot.. although she can return to the home village by ship and bring her team over, I didn't have time to add any real content for the other team members. Harlot will fight 3 types of dogs in Lupin and when she's strong enough, she can enter the Werewolf Tower and fight 3 bosses who each have a unique item. Here's an image of Lupin:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023020/b6838845ddede2fe60bdfd7fc05dab4ff1904ad6.jpg"]

In the Werewolf Tower fights, Harlot will need to beat stray dogs and build up her resistance to the Boss attacks, but it's worth it to find the treasures they protect:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023020/3f21071865a34a8cdb16a21f2cc46fc447187a59.jpg"]

Since Lupin village is late-game, I also spent a month adding in earlier content in ver.1.23: Pregnancy, Conditions, and Cooking. Pregnancy art works in the normal game events, and Harlot's belly has 3 sizes. She will get a baby at the end, which follows her around, and you can build a nursery in the basement too. Baby items are sold by the Merchant. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023020/a08ad8aa566bb67a25104f1ee4df045379d73e6b.jpg"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023020/dc17c6fdd08387e142710c9728c5d5a9366b65a0.jpg"]

Conditions are semi-permanent effects Harlot gets from different sex actions. There are 6 total, and they are visible in the Skills screen. Cooking can be done on any stove and there are 3 levels. Basic cooking only requires one ingredient and can be done anytime, Meals require hidden recipes that are hard to find, and Concoctions require rare items, but will tell you if you can craft them.

Note: You can disable Pregnancy, Baby, and Conditions in the Settings board behind the Hovel if you don't like them. Also, your saveFiles are NOT deleted and should be compatible with this update. The previous post explains how to find them and transfer them to the new updated game.

It's been about 4 months work on this update. I've tested it extensively but there are always bugs. Let me know if you find any serious ones!
